title: Customizations Rethink
description: B · Resolve — "Why is this available — or absent — here?" DevTools "Computed" for agents. Pick a context (file, agent, where it runs) and every instruction, skill, tool source, agent and hook is resolved with its reason: attached, available on demand, only with /name, or unavailable and why. The inspector leads with the verdict and its fix (sign in, set a secret, install a provider, add to an agent's tools: list, convert), edits applyTo with an unsaved preview, and keeps the full eligibility chain behind a disclosure. "Last Request" compares with a frozen record, never a recomputation. Vetted and cut by the design council (2 review rounds).
